Most goblin civilizations are ruled by a demon, this is normal in the world.

However one civilization, The Sculpted Vice is ruled by its own.

Located in the northern swamps and consisting of approximately 11,000 goblins, This dark civilization has been in constant war with the confederacy, only ceasing to make war on the elves.

Initially the civilization was ruled by the demon Zolak Hogwild who was mauled to death by tiger in the 4th year of his reign.

Proceeded by the Goblin Usbu Crushedplague who lost a duel to a titan

Succeeded by Osnun Equalmenaced who was mauled to death by a Jaguar.

The throne was then taken by Aslot Hatemyths , A siege operator in the conflict of Slings against the Elves of the Calm Twilight, n Immediately Aslot pushed the war front, turning what used to be skirmishes into massive open wars, cumlinating in one final battle.

The Battle of Conquerers

In the year 30 King Aslot led his goblins to the elven encampment and launched a full scale charge on the unprepared elves, Bursting through the stockade Aslot's fist action was a clean arrow through the forehead of Thalu Flyglistened, Queen of the elves.

Shocked by their Queens death, Princess Mina rallied a counterattack to drive the goblins out, many lives were lost to do this however in the melee the elven druid Yarare Earthenstoked managed to wound King aslot who was forced to retreat.

After the battle the dead numbers almost 800, one of the largest single battles in the history of Smata Olzul.

King Aslot claimed the title Aslot Hatemyths the Permanent Mansion of Weather

Present day

King Aslot still rules the Sculpted Vice today, he is the scourge of the swamps and one of the most powerful individuals in the world, hopefully a mighty adventurer can put an end to his reign.

The elves of the Calm Twilight were not so lucky, unable to recover from the war their civilization cumbled into dust over the following decade.
